title: IFR Clearance & Departure — Bankstown to Coffs Harbour

briefing.summary: You are at Bankstown ready to copy your IFR clearance for a flight to Coffs Harbour. ATIS information Mike has been received. Request clearance from Bankstown Tower.

transmission.speaker: pilot
transmission.text: Bankstown Tower, Lima Echo Foxtrot, IFR clearance to Coffs Harbour, information Mike.

question.prompt: You are ready to copy your IFR clearance. ATIS Mike is current. What is the correct initial call to Bankstown Tower?

options.text: Bankstown Tower, Lima Echo Foxtrot, request IFR clearance.
Bankstown Tower, Lima Echo Foxtrot, IFR clearance to Coffs Harbour, information Mike.
Bankstown, Lima Echo Foxtrot, ready to copy clearance for Coffs Harbour.
Lima Echo Foxtrot, Bankstown, IFR to Coffs, with Mike.

question.explanation: AIP GEN 3.4 standard initial call: addressed station, callsign, request type with destination, ATIS code. Order matters — addressed station first, your callsign next.

transmission.speaker: atc
transmission.text: Lima Echo Foxtrot, cleared to Coffs Harbour via flight planned route, climb to seven thousand, squawk four one two three.

transmission.speaker: pilot
transmission.text: Cleared to Coffs Harbour via flight planned route, climb to seven thousand, squawk four one two three, Lima Echo Foxtrot.

question.prompt: Bankstown has just issued your clearance. What is the correct readback?

options.text: Roger, cleared Coffs, climb seven thousand, squawk four one two three.
Cleared to Coffs Harbour via flight planned route, climb to seven thousand, squawk four one two three, Lima Echo Foxtrot.
Lima Echo Foxtrot copies the clearance, ready to taxi.
Cleared Coffs Harbour, climbing seven thousand, squawking four one two three.

question.explanation: AIP GEN 3.4 requires verbatim readback of: clearance limit, route, climb/altitude assignment, and squawk code, ending with your callsign. "Roger" is not an acknowledgement of a clearance.

transmission.speaker: atc
transmission.text: Lima Echo Foxtrot, readback correct, contact Ground one two one decimal seven for taxi.

transmission.speaker: pilot
transmission.text: Bankstown Ground, Lima Echo Foxtrot, ready for taxi, information Mike.

question.prompt: You've switched to Ground 121.7. What is the correct call to request taxi?

options.text: Ground, Lima Echo Foxtrot, taxi please.
Bankstown Ground, Lima Echo Foxtrot, ready to taxi to the holding point.
Bankstown Ground, Lima Echo Foxtrot, ready for taxi, information Mike.
Lima Echo Foxtrot, Bankstown Ground, with Mike, taxi.

question.explanation: AIP GEN 3.4: addressed station, callsign, request ("ready for taxi"), ATIS code if not already passed. Confirming ATIS to Ground avoids the controller asking.

transmission.speaker: atc
transmission.text: Lima Echo Foxtrot, taxi to holding point Alpha runway two nine right via Alpha, QNH one zero one eight.

transmission.speaker: pilot
transmission.text: Taxi to holding point Alpha runway two nine right via Alpha, QNH one zero one eight, Lima Echo Foxtrot.

question.prompt: Which items must be read back from Ground's taxi clearance?

options.text: Taxi to runway two nine right, Lima Echo Foxtrot.
Taxi to holding point Alpha runway two nine right via Alpha, QNH one zero one eight, Lima Echo Foxtrot.
Holding point Alpha, runway two nine right, Lima Echo Foxtrot.
Roger, taxiing Alpha, Lima Echo Foxtrot.

question.explanation: Required readback elements: runway in use, holding instructions / holding point, route via taxiways, QNH. Ending with callsign per AIP GEN 3.4.
